en.headline: Two pig-transport trucks overturn within four hours
en.dek: A 55-year-old driver was slightly hurt on Fanling Highway before a second truck flipped at Nathan Road in Yau Ma Tei.
body: Two medium goods vehicles carrying pig carcasses overturned in separate accidents early on Sunday, police said, leaving one driver with a minor injury.

At about 2:50am, a truck heading towards Kowloon on Fanling Highway overturned to the right near Hong Lok Garden. The 55-year-old male driver was briefly trapped, climbed out himself and was taken conscious to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital with a slight injury to his right hand. Reports said the load of more than 30 carcasses stayed largely on the vehicle. A recovery truck later righted the lorry and towed it away.

At about 4:30am, another truck travelling south on Nathan Road towards Tsim Sha Tsui struck roadside railings at the Waterloo Road junction and overturned. The male driver climbed out unhurt and reported the crash. Local media said he told officers the lights had turned red and he braked hard. About three metres of railing were damaged and skid marks of about 25 metres were left on the road.
Outlets reported that both vehicles belonged to the same company. Police are investigating the two accidents, including whether speed was a factor in the Yau Ma Tei crash.

zh.headline: 四小時內兩運豬車翻側 粉嶺公路司機輕傷
zh.dek: 粉嶺公路近康樂園一車翻側，55歲司機右手輕傷；其後油麻地彌敦道再有同類貨車撞欄翻側。
body: 警方表示，周日凌晨先後發生兩宗運載豬殼的中型貨車翻側意外，其中一名司機受輕傷。
約凌晨2時50分，一輛沿粉嶺公路往九龍方向行駛的貨車，駛至康樂園對開彎位時向右翻側。55歲男司機一度被困，其後自行爬出，清醒由救護車送往雅麗氏何妙齡那打素醫院，右手受輕傷。報道指車上三十多具豬殼大致未散落路面。拖車其後將貨車移正拖走。
約凌晨4時30分，另一輛沿彌敦道往尖沙咀方向的運豬車，駛至窩打老道交界燈位時撞向右側鐵欄，再向左翻側。男司機自行爬出，沒有受傷。本地傳媒引述他向警方表示，當時燈號轉紅，他緊急笞車後失控。現場約三米鐵欄損毀，路面留有約25米笞車胎痕。
有報道指兩車屬同一間公司。警方正調查兩宗意外成因，包括油麻地一案是否涉及車速過快。
